owner_intent: This completes the sector screenshots, including two central views north and south of the centre; together with the existing Wild Zone images, Trev reports whole-map image coverage. Preserve every original unchanged and process only duplicates.

source_game_orientation.evidence: Owner clarification retained in AT343 report; camera perspective is separate.

selection_policy: Retain each original unchanged and reference its exact hash.
Prefer a clearly readable sector label with the whole intended block/view in frame and surrounding road/building context.
Record clipping, UI/cursor/icon occlusion and unlock state where evidenced.
Compare new candidates with existing sector photographs before selecting a replacement; retain both originals and useful detail views.
Use shared landmarks and fixed north-up direction; crosses supply only the previously bounded relative alignment aid.
Review native coordinates, boundaries, pickups and routes separately; source image receipt does not approve them.
Intake further supplied photos when available; no background monitoring or automatic replacement is claimed.

collection_completion.statement: This completes the sector screenshots, including two central views north and south of the centre; together with the existing Wild Zone images, Trev reports whole-map image coverage.
collection_completion.meaning: Capture collection is complete. Source registration, seam/occlusion review and selection of working derivatives are separate remaining tasks.

centre_north.role: Bridge Prism Tower to the northern Rouge, Jaune and Magenta context.

centre_south.role: Bridge Prism Tower to southern Bleu and Vert context, including Wild Zone 5 and Vert Plaza.

transform parameters and review evidence when used for alignment

cross_alignment_policy.owner_hypothesis: The faint X/cross marks may provide map coordinates or an alignment grid because the source game map remains fixed north-up.
cross_alignment_policy.observed: Regular faint plus/cross marks repeat over the map and outside-city background.
cross_alignment_policy.use: Candidate secondary relative-alignment references after matching unique buildings, roads and canal features.
cross_alignment_policy.prior_bounded_evidence: AT343 supports one local photograph overlap only; its holdout limits remain binding.

survey_completion_scope: Owner-reported capture collection only; independent complete-map alignment and best-view approval remain pending.
